description: AccountNumber is mandatory and must not be NULL or empty (natural key).
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM curate.SavingsAccount WHERE AccountNumber IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(AccountNumber)) = ''

description: CustomerID is mandatory for curated rows and must not be NULL or empty.
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM curate.SavingsAccount WHERE CustomerID IS NULL OR LTRIM(RTRIM(CustomerID)) = ''

description: ProductCode is mandatory and must be one of the documented allowed values.
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM curate.SavingsAccount WHERE ProductCode IS NULL OR ProductCode NOT IN ('EASY_ACCESS','FIXED_1Y','NOTICE_90','ISA')

description: AccountStatus must be one of the documented enum values (OPEN, CLOSED, DORMANT, FROZEN).
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM curate.SavingsAccount WHERE AccountStatus IS NULL OR AccountStatus NOT IN ('OPEN','CLOSED','DORMANT','FROZEN')

description: Currency must be a 3-character ISO code and non-null (PoC expects 'GBP').
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM curate.SavingsAccount WHERE Currency IS NULL OR LEN(LTRIM(RTRIM(Currency))) <> 3

description: AccountOpenDate is mandatory and must not be in the future (must be <= current system date).
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM curate.SavingsAccount WHERE AccountOpenDate IS NULL OR CAST(AccountOpenDate AS date) > CAST(GETUTCDATE() AS date)

description: When ProductCode = 'FIXED_1Y' AccountMaturityDate must be populated; when populated AccountMaturityDate must be >= AccountOpenDate.
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM curate.SavingsAccount WHERE (ProductCode = 'FIXED_1Y' AND AccountMaturityDate IS NULL) OR (AccountMaturityDate IS NOT NULL AND AccountOpenDate IS NOT NULL AND AccountMaturityDate < AccountOpenDate)

description: If AccountStatus = 'CLOSED' then AccountCloseDate must be populated and AccountCloseDate must be >= AccountOpenDate and typically <= today.
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM curate.SavingsAccount WHERE (AccountStatus = 'CLOSED' AND AccountCloseDate IS NULL) OR (AccountCloseDate IS NOT NULL AND AccountOpenDate IS NOT NULL AND AccountCloseDate < AccountOpenDate) OR (AccountCloseDate IS NOT NULL AND CAST(AccountCloseDate AS date) > CAST(GETUTCDATE() AS date) AND AccountStatus = 'CLOSED')

description: InterestRate is mandatory and must be >= 0 and reasonably < 100 (percent).
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM curate.SavingsAccount WHERE InterestRate IS NULL OR InterestRate < 0 OR InterestRate >= 100

description: Balance is mandatory and must be >= 0; when AccountStatus = 'CLOSED' Balance must equal 0.00.
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM curate.SavingsAccount WHERE Balance IS NULL OR Balance < 0 OR (AccountStatus = 'CLOSED' AND Balance <> 0.00)

description: ValidFrom and ValidTo are mandatory and ValidFrom must be < ValidTo.
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM curate.SavingsAccount WHERE ValidFrom IS NULL OR ValidTo IS NULL OR ValidFrom >= ValidTo

description: Business key + ValidFrom must be unique: no two rows for the same AccountNumber may have identical ValidFrom.
rule_sql: SELECT s.* FROM curate.SavingsAccount s JOIN (SELECT AccountNumber,ValidFrom FROM curate.SavingsAccount GROUP BY AccountNumber,ValidFrom HAVING COUNT(*)>1) dup ON s.AccountNumber = dup.AccountNumber AND s.ValidFrom = dup.ValidFrom

description: ValidFrom/ValidTo ranges for the same AccountNumber must not overlap between different rows (SCD2 non-overlap).
rule_sql: SELECT a.* FROM curate.SavingsAccount a JOIN curate.SavingsAccount b ON a.AccountNumber = b.AccountNumber AND ( (a.ValidFrom <> b.ValidFrom) OR (a.ValidTo <> b.ValidTo) OR (a.LoadTimestamp <> b.LoadTimestamp) ) WHERE a.ValidFrom IS NOT NULL AND a.ValidTo IS NOT NULL AND b.ValidFrom IS NOT NULL AND b.ValidTo IS NOT NULL AND a.ValidFrom < b.ValidTo AND b.ValidFrom < a.ValidTo

description: Exactly one current row per AccountNumber must exist with ValidTo = '9999-12-31' (curate sentinel for current).
rule_sql: SELECT AccountNumber, COUNT(*) AS CurrentCount FROM curate.SavingsAccount WHERE ValidTo = '9999-12-31' GROUP BY AccountNumber HAVING COUNT(*) <> 1

description: LoadTimestamp must be populated and should be >= ValidFrom (ETL load time should not be earlier than the effective timestamp).
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM curate.SavingsAccount WHERE LoadTimestamp IS NULL OR (ValidFrom IS NOT NULL AND LoadTimestamp < ValidFrom)

description: Currency should match the PoC expectation 'GBP' (in this PoC Currency must be 'GBP').
rule_sql: SELECT * FROM curate.SavingsAccount WHERE Currency IS NOT NULL AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(Currency))) <> 'GBP'
